systems.owner: Civil Status Authority, Ministry of Interior, Government of National Unity
systems.tiers: 257 civil status offices across Libya, the authority's branches in the municipalities, had matched electronic data to paper records and scanned them by 3 September 2024, covering 1.8 million households, 97% of Libyan households

note: The civil registry offices are branches of a national authority located in the municipalities, not municipal offices; nothing is stated on the connection of local government offices.
